def add_page(self, title=None, content=None, old_url=None,
                 tags=None, old_id=None, old_parent_id=None):
        """
        Adds a page to the list of pages to be imported - used by the
        Wordpress importer.
        """
        if old_id is None:
            old_id = self.get_next_id()
        if old_parent_id is None:
            old_parent_id = self.get_next_parent_id()
        self.pages.append({
            'title': title,
            'content': content,
            'old_url': old_url,
            'old_id': old_id,
            'old_parent_id': old_parent_id,
            'tags': tags,
        })
